title: Characterisation of spatio-temporal trend in temperature extremes for environmental decision making in Bangladesh
authors: Md. Mohsan Khudri, Md. Shaddam Hossain Bagmar, Asef Mohammad Redwan
abstract: Spatial and sequential variability of extreme temperature events affects environmental decision making. This study analysed trends in monthly data of temperature extremes from 23 meteorological stations across Bangladesh using the Mann-Kendall test and Sen's slope estimator. Most stations exhibited significant upward trends in both temperature extremes, with the greatest concentration of significant trends detected during monsoon and post-monsoon seasons, informing regional climate vulnerability frameworks.
